title: Brake Fluid Level Sensor Circuit
shortDescription: Brake fluid level sensor circuit fault detected.
fullDescription: The ABS control module has detected an electrical fault with the brake fluid level sensor. The sensor monitors fluid in the master cylinder reservoir. Faulty signals may mask actual low-fluid warnings.
safetyImpact: Safety systems (ABS, ESC, suspension leveling) may be partially or fully disabled.
symptoms: ABS or stability control warning light

fixSteps.title: Read codes
fixSteps.instruction: Use a scan tool capable of reading chassis (C-prefix) codes from the ABS or suspension module.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring & sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect the suspect sensor and wiring for damage, especially near wheel wells or undercarriage areas.

fixSteps.title: Electrical tests
fixSteps.instruction: Verify supply voltage, ground integrity, and signal output per service manual specifications.

fixSteps.title: Component replacement & calibration
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the failed component and perform any required calibration (steering angle, ride height, yaw zero).

faq.q: Is it safe to drive with code C1100?
faq.a: It depends on severity. Driving with reduced safety system function or major engine faults is not recommended; have it diagnosed promptly.

faq.q: Will C1100 clear itself?
faq.a: Some codes self-clear after several successful drive cycles once the underlying issue is fixed. Others require a scan tool to clear.

faq.q: How much does it cost to fix C1100?
faq.a: Costs vary by component and labor rate. See the estimated cost ranges above for typical DIY and professional repair pricing.

fixSteps.title: Read codes
